documents.page_content:
Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines — 1. Seat Selection Rules
- **Interactive Seat Map:** For reserved-seating events (such as stadium concerts, auditorium comedy specials, and cinema screenings), customers can select specific seats directly on the interactive floor layout.
- **Seat Lock Mechanism:** When you select your seats and proceed to checkout, those seats are temporarily held under a **10-minute hold lock**. If payment is not completed within 10 minutes, the lock is automatically released back to the general inventory.
- **Contiguous Seating Rule:** To avoid single orphaned seats in auditoriums, bookings leaving an isolated single empty seat between selected seats and booked seats may be restricted during peak periods.

metadata.title: Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines — 2. Booking Limits & Restrictions
- **Maximum Tickets Per Transaction:** To prevent scalping and ensure fair access, customers can purchase a maximum of **10 tickets per order** for standard events, and **4 to 6 tickets per order** for high-demand concerts and exclusive premieres.
- **Multiple Transactions:** Users cannot place concurrent booking requests for the same event from the same account while a cart session is active.

metadata.title: Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines — 3. Supported Payment Methods
- **Accepted Modes:** We support all major Credit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), Debit Cards, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Net Banking across 50+ major banks, and Stripe Checkout.
- **Currencies Supported:** Primary transactions are processed in Indian Rupees (INR). International credit cards are accepted via the Stripe gateway with currency auto-conversion.
- **Payment Failures & Auto-Reversal:** If funds are debited from your bank account but the booking fails to generate a ticket due to gateway timeout, the transaction is marked as failed and funds are automatically refunded to your original source account within 3 to 5 business days.

metadata.title: Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines — 4. Digital Ticket Delivery
- **Instant Delivery:** Once payment is confirmed, an official E-Ticket is immediately dispatched to your registered email address and mobile phone via SMS/WhatsApp.
- **In-App & Chatbot Access:** You can also retrieve your active ticket anytime by asking the AI Assistant ("Show my booking status") or viewing the "My Bookings" tab on the user dashboard.
- **Ticket Format:** Digital tickets include a cryptographically secure 2D QR Code, unique Ticket ID (e.g., `TKT-XXXXXX`), event schedule details, venue gates, and designated seat numbers.

metadata.title: Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines — 5. E-Ticket Validation & Venue Access
- **QR Code Entry:** Present your digital e-ticket on your mobile device at the venue turnstiles or security scanners. Printed paper copies are also accepted but not mandatory.
- **Duplicate Scans:** Each QR code is strictly single-use. If a duplicate scan is detected at the entrance, access will only be granted to the original verified purchaser upon photo ID verification.
- **Ticket Transfers:** If transferring a ticket to a family member or friend, use the official "Transfer Ticket" button in your account dashboard at least 4 hours before gate opening.

metadata.title: Event Ticketing Platform - Booking FAQ & Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows — 1. User-Initiated Cancellations
Customers can request ticket cancellations directly through the AI Chatbot Assistant by stating "I want to cancel my booking" or by navigating to the "My Bookings" section on their profile.

metadata.title: Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows

documents.page_content:
Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows — 2. Cancellation Cutoff Window & Deadlines
- **Eligible Cancellation Period:** Ticket cancellations are permitted only if requested **at least 24 hours prior** to the published show start time.
- **Strict 24-Hour Cutoff Rule:** **No cancellations or refunds are permitted within 24 hours of the event.** For example, if your show is scheduled for 7:00 PM today, attempting to cancel 2 hours, 6 hours, or 12 hours before the show will be rejected by the system.
- **Why the Cutoff Exists:** Within 24 hours of a performance, artist fees, security staffing, and venue catering commitments are finalized, and released seats cannot reasonably be re-marketed to other fans.

metadata.title: Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows

documents.page_content:
Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows — 3. Cancellation Deductions & Tiers
For cancellations made outside the 24-hour cutoff window:
- **More than 7 days prior to event:** 90% refund of the ticket base price (10% standard processing fee).
- **Between 48 hours and 7 days prior to event:** 75% refund of the ticket base price (25% cancellation charge).
- **Between 24 hours and 48 hours prior to event:** 50% refund of the ticket base price (50% cancellation charge).
- **Less than 24 hours prior to event:** 0% refund (strictly non-refundable).

metadata.title: Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows

documents.page_content:
Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows — 4. Organizer-Initiated Cancellations & Force Majeure
- **Artist Sickness / Technical Failures:** In the rare event that an organizer or venue operator cancels an event due to weather, technical failure, or artist unavailability, the 24-hour cutoff rule is waived.
- **Immediate Status Update:** All ticket holders receive instant SMS and email notifications, and automated 100% refunds are triggered without requiring customer action.

metadata.title: Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows

documents.page_content:
Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows — 5. Non-Cancellable Ticket Types
- **Flash Sale & Early Bird Passes:** Tickets explicitly tagged as "Non-Refundable / Final Sale" during promotional flash sales cannot be cancelled voluntarily.
- **VIP Meet & Greet Experiences:** Due to limited artist access quotas, VIP packages cannot be cancelled within 14 days of the event.

metadata.title: Ticket Cancellation Policy & Cutoff Windows

documents.page_content:
Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ — 1. Venue Entry Requirements & Gate Timings
- **Gate Opening:** Venue gates typically open **90 minutes prior** to stadium concerts and **45 minutes prior** to theatre plays, stand-up comedy shows, and cinema screenings.
- **Last Entry:** Gates close 30 minutes after the performance commences. Late arrivals may have to wait until an intermission to take their seats to avoid disrupting other patrons.
- **Entry Documents:** Attendees must present their valid E-Ticket (printed or mobile QR code) along with matching identification.

metadata.title: Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ

documents.page_content:
Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ — 2. Mandatory Identification (ID Proof) Policies
- **Accepted Photo IDs:** Attendees must carry an official government-issued photo ID. Accepted forms include:
  - Aadhaar Card
  - Passport
  - Driver's License
  - Voter ID Card
  - Student / College ID (applicable only for discounted student passes)
- **Primary Booker Verification:** For group bookings, the primary purchaser whose name is printed on the master booking must be present at the gate or must have officially transferred tickets through the platform.

metadata.title: Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ

documents.page_content:
Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ — 3. Age Restrictions & Classification
- **Concerts & Music Festivals:** Children under 12 years of age are generally not permitted unless specified as a family show. Minors between 12 and 16 years must be accompanied by a ticket-holding adult (18+).
- **Stand-Up Comedy Shows:** Most comedy performances enforce a strict **16+ or 18+ age restriction** due to mature content and adult language.
- **Movie Screenings:** Adherence to CBFC ratings is mandatory:
  - **A (Adults Only):** Strictly 18+ only. Valid ID proof of age is verified at cinema podiums.
  - **U/A (Parental Guidance):** Children under 12 must be accompanied by parents.
  - **U (Universal):** Unrestricted public exhibition suitable for all ages.

metadata.title: Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ

documents.page_content:
Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ — 4. Prohibited Items Inside Venues
To ensure attendee safety and security, security personnel will conduct mandatory bag checks and metal detector screenings at all gates. The following items are strictly prohibited:
- **Outside Food & Beverages:** Outside snacks, beverages, fast food, and alcohol are strictly forbidden. Free drinking water stations and commercial concessions are available inside all venues. Exceptions are made solely for infant formula and prescribed medical dietary items.
- **Professional Recording Equipment:** DSLR cameras, detachable telephoto lenses, GoPros, tripods, selfie sticks, and professional audio/video recording rigs are banned. Smartphone cameras for personal use are permitted.
- **Dangerous Objects:** Sharp items, knives, scissors, firearms, fireworks, lasers, pepper spray, and flammable materials.
- **Smoking & Vaping:** Cigarettes, e-cigarettes, vape pens, and lighters are prohibited inside auditorium seating and enclosed halls. Designated smoking zones are provided outside stadium perimeters where permissible.
- **Large Backpacks & Luggage:** Bags larger than 30cm x 30cm x 15cm must be deposited at venue cloakrooms.

metadata.title: Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ

documents.page_content:
Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ — 5. Parking Facilities & Transportation
- **On-Site Parking:** Most indoor arenas, multiplexes, and mall venues (e.g., PVR Phoenix Palladium, Inorbit Malad, Cinepolis Viviana) offer multi-level paid vehicle parking with EV charging stations.
- **Stadium Event Advisory:** For major stadium concerts at DY Patil Stadium or JLN Stadium, parking is extremely limited and subject to traffic diversions. Attendees are strongly encouraged to use metro transit, suburban rail, or rideshare services (Uber/Ola).

metadata.title: Venue Entry, Security & Event Attendance FAQ

Every ticket purchased through our platform is backed by our comprehensive Buyer Protection Guarantee:

documents.page_content:
Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines — 1. Overview of Refund Policy
Our refund policy is designed to be fair, transparent, and prompt. Refund eligibility depends on whether the cancellation was initiated by the event organizer or requested by the attendee.

metadata.title: Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines — 2. Event Cancellations & Auto-Refunds
- **Organizer-Cancelled Events:** If an event, concert, or movie screening is cancelled by the event organizer, artist, or venue authorities, all ticket holders are entitled to a **100% full refund**.
- **Automatic Processing:** You do not need to submit a manual support ticket or refund request for cancelled events. Our platform triggers an automated batch refund within **24 to 48 hours** of the official cancellation announcement.
- **Components Covered:** The automatic cancellation refund covers the entire ticket base amount as well as applicable venue facility fees and taxes.

metadata.title: Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines — 3. Rescheduled & Postponed Events
- **Date or Venue Changes:** When an event is rescheduled to a new date, time, or venue, existing tickets automatically remain valid for the new date.
- **Refund Window for Rescheduled Shows:** Attendees who cannot attend the rescheduled date have a **72-hour grace period** from the announcement date to claim a full refund via the AI Assistant or customer support. After this window closes, standard cancellation terms apply.

metadata.title: Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines — 4. Refund Processing Timelines & Methods
- **Initiation Window:** Approved refund requests are processed and sent to banking networks within **24 to 48 hours**.
- **Bank Settlement Times:** Depending on your financial institution:
  - **UPI Payments:** Typically credited within **24 hours**.
  - **Debit / Credit Cards:** Credited within **5 to 7 business days** (excluding weekends and bank holidays).
  - **Net Banking:** Credited within **3 to 6 business days**.
- **Destination Account:** All refunds are strictly credited back to the original payment source (card, UPI ID, or bank account) used at checkout. Cash refunds are never issued.

metadata.title: Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines

documents.page_content:
Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines — 5. Non-Refundable Charges & Partial Refunds
- **Convenience / Platform Fees:** For voluntary user-initiated cancellations, third-party payment gateway convenience fees and platform processing fees are non-refundable.
- **Physical Merchandise & Add-ons:** Commemorative merchandise or physical memorabilia badges that have already been shipped or fulfilled prior to the cancellation request cannot be refunded.
- **No-Show Policy:** Attendees who do not arrive at the venue or fail to cancel before the specified cancellation window are not eligible for a refund.

metadata.title: Official Refund Policy & Processing Guidelines
